summary.en: Kogoro Mouri is hired by an anonymous customer later revealed to be Yumeno Arihara, whom he escorted along with the other member from the stage to dressing room 3 years ago but forgot about it anyway, to investigate an anonymous letter she received a week ago stating that they knew what she had done at that faithful day 3 years ago. Of course, the situation he is asked to investigate is also under the eavesdropping of Conan since he did not reveal anything to Ran and Conan before splitting. But here’s the catch: Both Conan and Arihara have already sensed that someone was actually following them. Arihara recalls the time when she was playing for the band called Albarosa consisting of Kensuke Domon as their drummer and band leader; Jotaro Tanemura as their guitarist; Yoji Kinomoto as their bass; while she was their main vocalist, which was the time when their donated money intended for charity were gone by unknown person, causing massive criticism, and the band to break up. Kogoro at first gives the statement that the two would soon deny: The anonymous must have thought her to be the one to steal it. Then the suspicion rises toward the other three members, that is also when Kogoro finally realizes that they have met each other 3 years ago in the aforementioned event.
